about: An open-source, AI-native vector design tool that turns designs and prompts into code.

prs.title: Exported text keeps its color
prs.broken: OpenPencil turns designs into web and app code. A text node's fill came out as a background, not a text color, in the HTML, Vue, Svelte, React and React Native exports.
prs.changed: Text fills now export as the text color. Other shapes keep their background.
prs.matters: Exported pages look like the design, with white text staying white on a dark box.
